title: The Synergism of β-Cyclodextrin and Fe3+ Enabled Anti-Swelling Ion-Conductive Hydrogels for Multimodal Underwater Sensing Aided by Machine Learning Algorithms.
summary: An anti-swelling conductive hydrogel retained underwater sensing properties and, with a Random Forest decoder, demonstrated five-letter underwater signal recognition; this is a controlled sensor proof-of-concept. Published in Advanced Science.
ai_technology: Methods/Results describe hydrogel performance, underwater signal data and Random Forest letter classification; the AI contribution is decoding the sensor signal, while material tests establish anti-swelling behavior.
organization: State Key Laboratory of Bio-Based Fiber Materials, Tianjin Key Laboratory of Brine Chemical Engineering and Resource Eco-Utilization, College of Chemical Engineering and Materials Science, Tianjin University of Science and Technology, Tianjin, China
